messages:
nisha: Heads-up — two enterprise customers asked for an "audit evidence API" to pull slices of audit logs for SOC2/ISO. needs: region pinning, per-tenant retention, and KMS custody proof.
tom: quick q — raw logs or masked outputs? any PII requirements yet?
nisha: both. gov customer wants raw (with strict access), retail bank wants masked exports. bank asked for reversible tokens; retail wants irreversible pseudonymization. both want KMS integration and attestations.
zain: ok — we should offer three modes: `none` (raw), `tokenize` (reversible), `pseudonymize` (irreversible). each mode has different controls & legal surface.
claire: can we do per-export SLAs? propose: streaming real-time (best-effort), scheduled bulk exports (24h SLA), ad-hoc large extracts (48h). need cost model.
legal-team: auditors will need chain-of-custody + signed attestation. if token escrow used we need explicit consent + ESCROW clause. also need export/access logs retained.
infra-bot: ticket created: INF-4821 evidence-api-v1. job queued for initial spike.
tom: tech sketch: API params: `masking_mode=none|tokenize|pseudonymize`, `key_source=customer-kms|redwood-kms`, `retention_override_days`, `region`. response: NDJSON preserving field names. rate limits apply.
zain: for `tokenize` with `customer-kms` we do envelope encryption and store tokens reversible only with customer's CMK. HSM audit logs enabled.
nisha: acceptance criteria (v0): 1) NDJSON output with same keys; 2) `tokenize` keeps referential integrity across events; 3) attestation doc with key IDs + signed digest; 4) region/TTL enforced; 5) legal-hold freezes supersede TTL.
claire: PM asks for cost breakdown: storage (tiered), export compute, egress, SRE ops margin. add to PRD.
legal-team: add e-discovery playbook and SLA commitments for subpoenas. draft SOW language for KMS escrow and for customer-managed keys.
tom: engineering owners: API (tom), token service (zain), KMS audit hookup (infra), retention/hard-delete enforcement (ops). timeline: spec in 2w, dev spike 4w, pilot EoQ.
zain: security note: use HMAC-SHA256 with per-customer key+nonce for tokens to reduce collision risk. document threat model.
nisha: comms: i'll draft FAQ + decision matrix (which mode when). keeps customers expectations clear. :thumbsup:
legal-team: also map to SOC2/ISO controls (CC6 / A.8) for signoff checklist.
infra-bot: tech review meeting booked Thu 3pm. invite sent.
nisha: adding epic to roadmap: "evidence export API v1" with modes, SLA, acceptance criteria. tagging owners. ping if you need sample payloads.
